compute_self_distillation_loss: compute the self-distillation loss between student and teacher model logits with optional top-k and importance sampling clipping
compute_divergence: compute KL divergence between student and teacher log probabilities with configurable alpha mixture weighting
aggregate_self_distillation_loss: aggregate per-token distillation losses using GRPO, BNPO, DR-GRPO, or token-level normalization strategies
compute_token_level_distillation_loss: compute token-level reverse-KL surrogate loss using score-function gradient estimator
apply_importance_sampling_clipping: apply importance sampling clipping to distillation loss ratios for stable policy optimization
